Published in *Tourism Management*, vol. 77. [doi:10.1016/j.tourman.2019.104010](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.tourman.2019.104010)

Uses mobile phone network data to estimate the nationwide economic value of coastal tourism in Japan and how climate change may reshape it.
